name: Drone Scout
summary:
In Drone Scout, every mission starts with something missing and one tiny drone ready to save the day.

Pilot a nimble quadcopter through a bright low-poly neighborhood, scanning streets, yards, parks, rooftops, and hidden corners to track down misplaced objects. From baseball bats and library books to keys, gift cards, and one very important guitar case, each level gives you a new item to recover and a new slice of town to explore.

Simple flying controls make it easy to lift off, look around, and enjoy the search, while each successful find brings a satisfying little rescue moment. Whether you are sweeping over sidewalks, hovering near backyards, or carefully checking around buildings, Drone Scout is all about calm exploration, observation, and the small joy of finding what was lost.
